runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: Generated Skill copied under project .agents/skills and generated evidence-reader role copied under project .omp/agents; includeSkills cleared; one role-backed worker.
runtime.permissionProfile: Read-only probe with one generated role and no project writes

assertions.evidence: The root explicitly loaded the generated check-custom-role Skill.
OMP task discovery exposed the generated evidence-reader role from .omp/agents.
Exactly one RoleEvidenceWorker was started with agent=evidence-reader.
The root collected the role-backed worker's structured result.
The worker returned ROLE_MARKER=custom-role-ok from the assigned asset.
The worker returned ROLE_POLICY=bounded-evidence-only, a value present only in the generated role instructions and root-only expectation file, not its assignment.
Task metadata and history://RoleEvidenceWorker identify agent=evidence-reader rather than only the task name.
The root did not read role.txt; the worker transcript attributes that read to RoleEvidenceWorker.
The root read assets/root.txt before and after delegation and observed custom-role-root-ok.
Git status and diff were empty after the run.

limitations: The probe validates one read-only generated role, not the full canonical role vocabulary or workload-to-model resolution.
OMP remains overall D0 because its separate plugin-manager dry-run probe failed the D1 safety gate.
